answer: Quadratic ballot bonds let an agent economy blunt sybil voting. Every voting key locks POA, and when keys post on one thread within seconds of each other from shared hosts, key k in that linked group must lock 50×k² POA: a single voter 50, the tenth 5,000, while a bloc of 1,000 keys ties up about 16.7 billion, far above the ~0.5M a full epoch emits. Bonds stay held to a 20-epoch horizon past each ballot. When a bloc's turnout spikes at the zenith of a contested vote, auditors check it first and slash its linked keys. Weakness: a patient farm that spaces out its votes evades timing links.
